scenes.narration: A cozy gift for the hottest sleeper? She sleeps with the window open.
scenes.visual: b-roll:two people on a couch, one under three blankets, one fanning themselves

scenes.narration: A weighted blanket gift starts with one question: hot or cold sleeper? Stay for the weight rule.
Runs warm? A knit blanket from thick yarn, with no beads. Mattress Clarity calls it incredibly breathable.
Always cold? A glass-bead blanket holds warmth. Reviewed named one its best weighted blanket.
Need an exact weight or a bed size? One maker offers 10 weights, from 5 to 30 pounds.
Pick about 10 percent of their body weight. A 150 pound adult starts near 15.
scenes.visual: product:a folded weighted blanket with a weight label

scenes.narration: Not for babies, ever. And include a gift receipt in case the weight feels wrong.
scenes.onScreen: Not for babies. Add a receipt.

scenes.narration: The knit one goes to your sister. The window stays open. Everyone wins. The full comparison is at the link.
